items.briefing:
A new unfiltered AI platform called "Kriminal" is making it easier for cybercriminals to create malicious tools without ethical guardrails, raising concerns about a rise in sophisticated attacks against everyday organisations. Separately, new data shows that mid-market businesses — those too large to be overlooked but often under-resourced for security — now account for 73% of ransomware victims. Australian training organisations likely fall into this category and should take note. A separate exploit linked to the Clop ransomware group is also actively targeting enterprise software, signalling continued aggressive activity from organised criminal groups.

**Practical tip:** If your organisation hasn't tested its data backups recently, do it today — ensure backups are stored offline or separately from your main network so ransomware can't reach them.

featured.title: No-Filter 'Kriminal' AI Platform Raises Cybercrime Concerns
